model_choice: Exact MCLP with auxiliary coverage variables. 2N binary variables (N stations + N coverage indicators). Fits CGA backend because N~280 => 560 vars, well below 3,600 limit. Constraints are linear and handled by the system.

districts.meaning: Unique identifier for each district center candidate

prep.notes: Extracted village names and total population from the age-distribution table by filtering for the latest period, village level, and total gender. Added district parent to village names to ensure unique keys. Converted projected coordinates from the boundary table to WGS84 lat/lon. Joined tables on [district, village_name] to resolve ambiguous village names. Deduplicated boundary table by [district, village_name] to resolve 2 duplicate rows, resulting in 454 unique villages. Intersection with population data yields 453 villages with valid population and coordinates. Output contains all valid villages in Taipei with their population and center coordinates.
